Al Moammar Information Systems (MIS)
operates in the healthcare technology space through its specialized subsidiary, Excellence Medical Systems (EMS), which
provides digital health solutions, medical equipment, and turnkey project management for healthcare providers
. While MIS builds the IT and digital health infrastructure for medical institutions rather than manufacturing consumer wearables, remote patient monitoring (RPM) ecosystems leverage these enterprise platforms to aggregate data from devices like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, and sleep trackers.
